atoms.exact_source_text: Numerical population bands and advancement thresholds are reference targets for sourcebook authoring and balance.
atoms.normalized_claim: Numerical population bands and advancement thresholds are reference targets for sourcebook authoring and balance, not fixed canon.

atoms.exact_source_text: They may move during implementation testing without changing the governing doctrine, provided the low-population ceiling and species-relative scale remain intact.
atoms.normalized_claim: Reference-target bands/thresholds may move during implementation testing without changing governing doctrine, provided the low-population ceiling and species-relative scale remain intact.

atoms.exact_source_text: MEDIAN is a low-population colony builder.
atoms.normalized_claim: MEDIAN is a low-population colony builder.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Colony is not a stream of replaceable workers but a finite set of named Citizens whose ordinary responsibilities, absences, injuries, relationships, births, arrivals, and deaths remain comprehensible.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Colony is not a stream of replaceable workers but a finite set of named Citizens whose ordinary responsibilities, absences, injuries, relationships, births, arrivals, and deaths remain comprehensible.

atoms.exact_source_text: At Home, a present and available adult Citizen contributes one equal unit of Role Capacity.
atoms.normalized_claim: At Home, a present and available adult Citizen contributes one equal unit of Role Capacity.

atoms.exact_source_text: That equality does not make population growth automatically beneficial.
atoms.normalized_claim: Equal Role Capacity contribution does not make population growth automatically beneficial.

atoms.exact_source_text: Every new resident also requires a credible Place to live, consumes Sustenance, and may increase Caretaking, Stores, Watchkeeping, Teaching, Healing, Leadership, route, or structural Load.
atoms.normalized_claim: Every new resident requires a credible Place to live, consumes Sustenance, and may increase Caretaking, Stores, Watchkeeping, Teaching, Healing, Leadership, route, or structural Load.

atoms.exact_source_text: Population is therefore capability plus obligation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Population is capability plus obligation.

atoms.exact_source_text: A new adult may add one Capacity today.
atoms.normalized_claim: A new adult may add one Capacity today.

atoms.exact_source_text: A young Citizen adds no Capacity yet.
atoms.normalized_claim: A young Citizen adds no Capacity yet.

atoms.exact_source_text: Both add a life the Colony must feed, shelter, teach, protect, and remember.
atoms.normalized_claim: Both a new adult and a young Citizen add a life the Colony must feed, shelter, teach, protect, and remember.

atoms.exact_source_text: Home grows the Colony: more inhabited Places, more civic commitments, more reserves, more relationships, and eventually a higher Tier.
atoms.normalized_claim: Home grows the Colony: more inhabited Places, more civic commitments, more reserves, more relationships, and eventually a higher Tier.

atoms.exact_source_text: Away grows particular Citizens: equipment, wounds, Distinctions, fears, Tales, and After-names.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away grows particular Citizens: equipment, wounds, Distinctions, fears, Tales, and After-names.

atoms.exact_source_text: Population growth belongs principally to Home and Homecoming, even when the first contact occurs Away.
atoms.normalized_claim: Population growth belongs principally to Home and Homecoming, even when the first contact occurs Away.

atoms.exact_source_text: Hundreds of anonymous inhabitants or population represented primarily as labor throughput.
atoms.normalized_claim: A non-goal of this specification is hundreds of anonymous inhabitants or population represented primarily as labor throughput.

atoms.exact_source_text: A breeding optimizer, heredity system, bloodline ledger, genetics screen, or inherited aptitude.
